# `Q-3-31` — Unprocessed Note Reference

> Note reference was not converted to Span during
> postprocessing. This may indicate a bug or a filter that
> bypassed postprocessing.

## What this means

Footnote references are written `[^id]` in the source but they
do not stay in that form for output formats that cannot render
them natively. The postprocessor converts each `NoteReference`
AST node into a `Span` that contains the rendered marker (a
linked superscript, for instance). This error fires when a raw
`NoteReference` survives that pass.

This is a defensive guard. A document author cannot fix it from
the source — the failure is in the pipeline, not in the input.

## Why this happens

Two known triggers:

- **A Lua filter bypassed postprocessing**, for example by
  running after the conversion pass and re-introducing
  `NoteReference` nodes.
- **A bug in the postprocessor** that misses a particular
  reference shape.

## How to fix

If a custom filter is in use, ensure it does not produce
`NoteReference` AST nodes after postprocessing. If no filter is
in use, report the document at the Quarto issue tracker — a
minimal reproducer is the most helpful form.

## Related

- `Q-3-12` — the same condition surfaced as a postprocessor-bug
  diagnostic, where the writer is more confident it is the
  pipeline at fault.
